hooks.name: Session Start Context
hooks.description: 新 session 開始時顯示目前工作樹、近期提交與本機 Python 環境狀態

action.command: echo '=== TrustForge Session Context ==='; git status --short --branch; echo '--- Recent commits ---'; git log --oneline -5; echo '--- Local environment ---'; test -x .venv/bin/python && .venv/bin/python --version || echo '.venv unavailable'
